provenance_quote: strains translocate the bacterial protein CagA into gastric epithelial cells by a type IV secretion system, encoded by the cag pathogenicity island.
notes: Crossref: Odenbreit et al. 2000 Science, title 'Translocation of Helicobacter pylori CagA into Gastric Epithelial Cells by Type IV Secretion'; DOI resolves. UniProt P55980 active = cagA, H. pylori 26695 (HP_0547), classified onco_T4SS_CagA. Identity fields all correct.

provenance_quote: a large group of effectors (Lpg0103/VipF, Leg0208/LegK4, Lpg0437/Ceg14, Lpg1368/Lgt1, Lpg1488/Lgt3, Lpg2504/SidI, and Lpg2862/Lgt2) shown to manipulate eukaryotic protein translation
notes: Crossref: Patel et al. 2024 Mol Syst Biol, atlas of Legionella Dot/Icm translocated effectors; DOI resolves. Quote lists Lpg0437/Ceg14 as a Dot/Icm effector. uniprot is '-' so na. Locus LPG_RS02190 (=lpg0437) consistent. ss_type T4SS correct (Dot/Icm).

provenance_quote: The effector proteins (CBU0021, CBU0937, CBU1823, CBU1825 and CBU2013) were mainly associated with autophagy.
notes: Quote verbatim-present in Fu et al. 2022 PLoS Pathog (PMID 35816513, PMC9273094, DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1010660); CBU0937 listed among Coxiella Dot/Icm effectors. UniProt Q83D09 active = CBU_0937, C. burnetii RSA493; locus/organism/ss_type correct. CAVEAT: neither the cited ref nor UniProt uses the gene name 'CirD' (UniProt name 'UPF0422 protein CBU_0937'); cited ref is a PPI map listing CBU0937 among effectors, not a primary CBU0937 translocation assay. PubMed found no dedicated CBU0937 translocation paper. Gene-name alias unverified but echoed verbatim; verdict fields all correct.

provenance_quote: the VirB/D4 system is also involved in the translocation of several effector proteins, including VirE2, VirE3 and VirF into the host cell cytoplasm.
notes: VirE3 is a genuine Agrobacterium VirB/D4 T4SS effector (Padavannil et al. 2014 PLoS Pathog, DOI resolves; quote present in intro). BUT cited UniProt P08061 = 'VirE locus 9 kDa virulence protein' (virE0/Atu6188), only 83 aa, NOT the VirE3 effector. The real full-length VirE3 effector in A. fabrum C58 is A0A2Z2PK47 (684 aa, gene virE3/Atu6191, Pfam PF06661 VirE3, InterPro IPR009550 VirE3). new_uniprot corrects the accession; effector real and secreted, only the accession is wrong.

provenance_quote: These translocated effector proteins (Beps) A-G are encoded together with the VirB system and the T4S coupling protein VirD4 on a [Bartonella]-specific pathogenicity island.
notes: Schulein et al. 2005 PNAS (DOI resolves), Beps A-G translocated via VirB/VirD4 T4SS. UniProt Q6G2A9 active = bepA, B. henselae Houston-1, annotated 'type IV secretion system effector', 'Secreted', 'Translocated into the host cell via the T4SS'. Identity fields correct.

provenance_quote: translocation of BtpA-CyaA and CyaA-BtpB was clearly reduced in a virB genetic background, indicating that delivery of both proteins is dependent on the T4SS.
notes: Salcedo et al. 2013 Front Cell Infect Microbiol (PMID 23847770, PMC3703528, DOI 10.3389/fcimb.2013.00028; resolves) identifies BtpB as BAB1_0756 in B. abortus 2308 and shows VirB-T4SS-dependent translocation. BUT cited UniProt Q2YNA0 = BAB1_0782 'DUF2069 domain-containing protein' with 4 TM helices, NOT BtpB. Correct BtpB accession is Q2YN91 = BAB1_0756 'TIR domain-containing protein' (Pfam PF13676 TIR_2; paper says BAB1_0756). Q2YPC4 (BAB1_0279) is BtpA/Btp1/TcpB, not BtpB. Genome NC_007618.1 (chr I) correct; only accession wrong.

provenance_quote: This analysis resulted in the identification of the proteins encoded by BAB1_1652 (VceA) and BR1038/BAB1_1058 (VceC) as novel protein substrates of the Brucella T4SS
notes: De Jong et al. 2008 Mol Microbiol (DOI resolves; quote from Crossref-confirmed abstract) identifies VceC (BAB1_1058) as a novel substrate of the Brucella VirB T4SS. uniprot '-' so na. Locus BAB_RS26945 maps to BAB1_1058 region. ss_type T4SS correct. Citation_quote verbatim-correct.

provenance_quote: we screened a genomic DNA library of Anaplasma phagocytophilum for effectors of the type IV secretion system... A hypothetical protein was identified as a putative effector, hereby named Anaplasma translocated substrate 1 (Ats-1)
notes: Niu et al. 2010 PLoS Pathog (DOI resolves), Ats-1 identified as A. phagocytophilum T4SS effector imported to host mitochondria. UniProt Q2GJL5 active = ats-1, APH_0859 (=APH_RS03430), A. phagocytophilum HZ; interacts with host BECN1. Identity fields correct.

provenance_quote: Ehrlichia type IV secretion effector ECH0825 is translocated to mitochondria and curbs ROS and apoptosis by upregulating host MnSOD
notes: Liu et al. 2012 Cell Microbiol (DOI resolves; quote = article title from Crossref). ECH0825/Etf-1 is a T4SS effector translocated to host mitochondria. UniProt Q2GG12 = ECH_0825 (=ECH_RS03425), E. chaffeensis Arkansas; UniProt label 'uncharacterized' but locus+organism match the paper's ECH0825. ss_type T4SS correct.
